comparison.objective: Fold sprung carton flaps in the required order; candidate tunes and locks an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR holds spring-returning flaps while folding covering flaps. Candidate uses a fine hex tool and collar, then operates a separate test control.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires all four flaps closed in order and still for 1 s. Candidate requires two consecutive safe stopping cycles plus retained adjustment. PR lacks a separate task specification, but its body states the decisive rubric.
comparison.reason: Shared spring resistance and sequencing are generic; flap containment does not test tool reacquisition, locking, or measured impact response.
